question: Who among the following personalities is/was NOT an Indian Ghazal singer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhimsen Joshi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhimsen Joshi:-**

 
 
• He was a renowned classical vocalist from India.
 
 
 
• **Ghazal:-**
 
 
• It is a form of poetry that originated in Arabic and Persian literature.
 
• It is characterized by its lyrical and romantic themes. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Begum Akhtar:-**

 
 
• She is also known as Akhtari Bai Faizabadi, was born in 1914 in Faizabad, India.
 
• She was one of the most popular Ghazal singers of the 20th century, and was known for her unique style and voice.
 
 
 
• **Chitra Singh:-**
 
 
• She is a Ghazal singer from India, who gained fame in the 1970s and 80s for her duets with her husband Jagjit Singh.
 
• They were known as the "King and Queen of Ghazals".
 
 
 
• **Jagjit Singh:-**
 
 
• She was born in 1941 in Rajasthan, India.
 
• He was a pioneer of the modern Ghazal movement in India, and his music blended traditional Indian classical music with Western instruments and arrangements.
 
• He passed away in 2011, leaving behind a rich legacy of Ghazal music.
